mcp_data: explicitly synthetic local material; never supplier REST
qualification: 12-case feasibility only; does not establish Q3 95 percent stability

capture.order: original item/started notifications; completion updates same item without reordering
capture.retain: fresh test thread/turn, native events, provider trace/usage, original failures, final outcome
capture.hosted_visibility: must be declared complete/partial/unknown; absence alone does not prove no provider search

limits.money_limit_rule: no positive amount assumed; price snapshot and monetary admission must be reviewed before live execution
limits.hosted_limit_rule: observed stopping threshold is not a hard cap on unobservable provider-internal work

reuse.reasoning_budget: existing native token/rollout/Goal; no Host token counter
reuse.goal: do not create an extra Goal or change user budgets
reuse.meter_handoff: existing two-model meter has no FEAT-175 purpose yet; add and qualify that scope before live use, never borrow other tasks authorization

stop_conditions: any unapproved egress or actual supplier REST attempt
model or hosted evidence incomplete: preserve as inconclusive, not pass
current budget exhausted or an unknown-cost operation
structural hosted presearch versus MCP selection conflict
three equivalent failures require a root-cause review before further attempts
live_execution_entry: not enabled in this preparation package
